_about: The trailer's painted cinematic shots (T5), MiniMax H3 through ComfyUI: python trailer/tools/h3.py trailer/ai/shots.json. Prompts follow MiniMax's official format (instruction line, integrated_multimodal_description, overall_soundscape, non_diegetic_music). Always the game's painted 2D style, never photoreal. First frames are made from the mod's own paintings (trailer/ai/frames/).

jobs.name: a1_donald_hero
jobs.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2D-animated, painterly digital illustration with flat graphic shapes, soft painted shading and visible brush texture, matching <Picture 1>. A low-angle medium shot shows the heavyset man from <Picture 1> with swept blond hair, a navy suit, a white shirt and a long red tie, a golden shovel resting on his right shoulder and his left hand on his hip, standing in front of a towering wall of dark green bricks with thin gold mortar lines, a deep red sky filling the left of the frame. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward his face. Glowing orange embers drift upward across the red sky. He raises his chin and narrows his eyes. A bright gold glint travels along the edge of the shovel blade. Along the top of the wall, a new row of gold-edged green bricks slides into place, each brick landing with a small puff of dust.

overall_soundscape: A low wind blows steadily while the embers crackle softly. Heavy bricks thud into place one after another with a gritty scrape, and a bright metallic ring sounds as the glint crosses the shovel blade.

non_diegetic_music: N/A

jobs.name: a2_joe_eyes
jobs.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2D-animated, painterly digital illustration with flat graphic shapes, soft painted shading and visible brush texture, matching <Picture 1>. A medium close-up shows the smiling white-haired man from <Picture 1> in gold-rimmed aviator sunglasses with dark lenses, a navy suit and a blue tie, arms crossed, leaning against a green 1960s sports car on a rocky ledge under a starry night sky with a crescent moon and a distant tower. His smile fades and his head slowly droops forward, his shoulders sinking as he dozes, his chin nearly touching his chest. Then his head snaps upright. The lenses of his sunglasses ignite with a blazing solid red glow that throws red light across his cheeks and brow, and a wide confident grin spreads across his face. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward his face as a red glow pulses across the night sky behind him.

overall_soundscape: Crickets chirp in the still night air. A soft, slow snore fades away, followed by a sharp electric crackle and a deep humming charge as the lenses light up.

non_diegetic_music: N/A

jobs.name: a3_brandon_rises
jobs.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2D-animated, painterly digital illustration with flat graphic shapes, soft painted shading and visible brush texture, matching <Picture 1>. A low-angle wide shot shows the white-haired man from <Picture 1> in a navy suit and aviator sunglasses with glowing red lenses, standing on a dark rocky peak with his arms spread wide, a huge red sun behind him and torn red banners around him. The camera pushes in with large amplitude at slow speed toward him. His red lenses flare brighter and brighter, then two thick red laser beams fire from the lenses straight toward the camera, washing the rocks in red light. The torn red banners whip in a strong wind and glowing embers stream upward past him.

overall_soundscape: A strong wind roars across the peak and the banners snap and flutter. A rising electric whine builds and bursts into a deep, crackling laser blast.

non_diegetic_music: N/A

jobs.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2D-animated, painterly digital illustration with flat graphic shapes, soft painted shading and visible brush texture, matching <Picture 1>. A medium shot shows the grinning white-haired man from <Picture 1> in aviator sunglasses with glowing red lenses, gripping the lapels of his navy suit jacket with both hands, fire and yellow lightning crackling behind his right shoulder against a dark navy sky. He pulls his jacket wide open as a burst of yellow lightning and orange flame erupts behind him, and his red lenses flare bright white-red. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at fast speed toward his face. Sparks and embers blow across the frame.

overall_soundscape: Fabric snaps as the jacket is pulled open. Thunder cracks and flames roar in a sudden burst, followed by the crackle of flying sparks.

jobs.name: a4_title_walk_s21
jobs.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2D-animated, painterly digital illustration with flat graphic shapes, soft painted shading and visible brush texture, matching <Picture 1>. A wide shot shows the two men from <Picture 1> walking side by side straight toward the camera across dark cracked rock: on the left, the man with swept blond hair, a navy suit and a long red tie carrying a golden shovel over his shoulder; on the right, the white-haired man in a navy suit and aviator sunglasses with glowing red lenses. Behind them a colossal dark stone tower with glowing orange windows stands under a stormy sky. They keep striding forward with steady, confident steps as a huge explosion of gold coins and red-orange fire bursts outward behind them, throwing a wave of spinning gold coins past them toward the camera. The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed, keeping both men centered as their jackets and the red tie flap in the blast wind.

overall_soundscape: A deep explosion booms and rolls behind them, followed by a rain of clinking gold coins scattering across the rock. Their shoes crunch on the stone with each step while the wind howls.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
